name: Ijimerarekko ni Happy End wa Odozureru no ka
original_name: いじめられっ子にハッピーエンドは訪れるのか
source:
Choose whether to save or not Mitsuki, a bullied girl.

This visual novel has 3 endings, however all of them will leave a bad aftertaste.
